Compare the warm trace with the retained uninterrupted native turn and with n98 only after input and policy fidelity is established. A trace produced under different always-allow/always-deny choices may explain a branch but cannot by itself establish a defect.

conclusions: The diagnostic probe was executed and stopped exactly as designed; exits 2/2 represent the retained fidelity failure, not a wrapper or artifact failure.
The probe narrows the next evidence need but establishes no simulation defect, no policy defect, and no uninterrupted first cause.
